breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal axial force as uniform along the entire bar, even though point loads make the axial force piecewise constant with jumps at the loading points.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification assigns the same internal axial force of 13000 N to all three segments (AB, BC, CD), directly repeating the error of treating the force as uniform along the full bar. The correct approach requires piecewise analysis giving different forces per segment (AB=13000 N, BC=2000 N, CD=−10000 N).

breakdown.description: The prompt reduces the problem to one net-load stress state, which conflicts with the need to resolve different internal forces and displacements segment by segment.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification computes a single stress of 26 MPa for all segments and a total displacement based on this uniform state, which mirrors the flawed single net-load approach. A correct segment-by-segment analysis yields three different stresses and a total displacement of approximately 0.069 mm, not 0.182 mm.
